items.title: Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1959-01-02
items.q: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes' mother and my mother, two sisters.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. He teach me by ear. That's how I learned first. But I learned music long, long years after when I put up my own band with Bush Hall's name, Paul Barnes, my brother, Edward Moreira, bass violin, and my cousin Josiah Frazier on drums.
Oh, while we're talking about that, how are you related to Paul Barnes and Emil Barnes, of course. They're cousins too, aren't they?
Well, I'm the first cousin Bill. Well, uh.
